title: Find a member by last name and date of birth
description: Searches members by last name, picks the one with the given date of birth, and returns their member number and name.
goal: Sign on, search for members with the last name {{inputs.lastName}}, open the one born on {{inputs.dob}}, and read their member number and name.

memberNumber.description: the member's number, from their member page

memberName.description: the member's name, from their member page

probes.why: a last name no member has
